narrative: Day 6 is a cold, clear Monday and the busiest office day of the week so far, with all work still in the Tashkent office and nobody at the Qizilqum site. The PEP Rev A inputs fall due today: Aziz Karimov compiles the comprehensive Project Execution Plan from the engineering, procurement, construction, HSE and risk inputs, and Rajan Iyer reviews and approves it for internal issue. Arun Pillai issues the first revision of the Project Quality Management Plan, and QSE returns its comments on the draft Advance Payment Guarantee and Performance Security forms as agreed at the Kick-off Meeting.
